verdict.rationale: Expensify Travel supports booking flights/hotels/cars/rail (expensify-docs-16) and claims trips 'don't end in a pile of receipts' (expensify-docs-8), while SmartScan auto-captures receipt data (expensify-docs-6, expensify-docs-18) and BYOC lets any card's spend flow in (expensify-docs-5, expensify-docs-21). However, no evidence explicitly shows these three streams (bookings, card transactions, receipts) auto-merging into one itinerary-linked report, and community feedback flags real categorization/accuracy issues with receipt processing (expensify-comm-1, expensify-comm-4). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic itinerary-to-report linkage, evidence of card-transaction matching to trip itineraries, and independent confirmation the unified report actually works end-to-end.
